work.title: Non-Contact Flood Monitoring System
work.problem: Flood alerts fail when internet and power fail. Physical water sensors suffer corrosion and debris obstruction during typhoon surge conditions.
work.action: Engineered a computer-vision water-level measurement pipeline with resilient multi-path emergency alerts over BitChat/Bluetooth mesh, SMS, and Telegram fallback channels.
work.result: Working physical prototype; rigorously tested water-level accuracy and alert delivery across simulated offline states; seeking funding or scholarship support for the flood-monitoring prototype.

work.title: Hat-a-See: Wearable Assistive Hat
work.problem: Visually impaired individuals face head-level obstacles that traditional canes cannot detect; existing sensor hats trigger echo crosstalk and disorienting feedback.
work.action: Integrated Arduino UNO, HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensors, vibration motors, and a micro servo. Programmed step-scan servo logic and sequential sensor firing to completely eliminate acoustic crosstalk, paired with dynamic distance-based vibration pulse rates.
work.result: Full hardware and firmware lifecycle completed with wiring plans, user guide, and presentation.

work.title: Quantitative Trading Pipeline
work.problem: Standard machine learning models overfit on non-stationary market time-series, yielding spurious backtests without robust statistical deflators or combinatorial cross-validation.
work.action: Constructed a nine-notebook pipeline following Marcos López de Prado methodology: fractional differentiation, triple-barrier labeling, meta-labeling, purged cross-validation, CPCV, Deflated Sharpe Ratio; multi-agent design with a live micro-capital track on Alpaca.
work.result: Final testing phase. Complete methodology implemented without heuristic curve-fitting. (Note: no performance claims or ROI claims presented, in compliance with scientific rigor).
